exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the existing historical Silent Storm original SOFT PAINTED COLOR footprint into a faithful higherresolution bitmap. Not new realistic physical object or new effectsimulation.

Image1 is EXACT ENTIRE native storedRGB solely wholecanvas NEAREST enlargement from32x32 to512x512, opaque to expose originalpaint. Preserve complete edge-to-edge normalizedUV, all original positions/shape/width/count/phase/nativepaintscale/palette/localrelative strengths. Nearest pixels prove originalpositions only: render original smooth softwash, NOT grid/squaredcells/mosaic/granules/stipple. Original fullA is restored independently downstream; only ONE global brightness scalar, no crop/padding/frame/zoom/recenter/BBox/fitting/repacking.

ONE compact original asymmetric muted brown/redgray PAINTED color footprint. Keep two existing dim upper projections separated by the exact original black topnotch, original middlegray/brown wash, existing small darkpigment pocket around native[17,14,19,16], and original lower softer warmer wash. These are exact source painted tonal domains, NOT a physical part or metalobject. Keep original uneven shortprojections/tapers and all black gaps without turning the darkpaint pocket into a newly outlined hole/cavity/ring/bevel. Do not draw bolts/rust/cracks, do not reshape to a neat U or any hardware.

Exact original nativeRGBA extrema are [[0, 86], [0, 50], [0, 49], [0, 255]]; source maximum mean pigment native xy[20, 14] is exact RGBA[74, 50, 46, 255]. Keep all original darkbrown/gray vsmoderate lightgray source relationships, original verydimpaint and sourceblack gaps. Do not assign255/white peaks or locally strengthen lightgray edges. NativeTransparent A0..255 is restored separately; guide staysopaque.

Source material is deliberately matte and softly blurred, with broad subtle painted washes. Add only finer depiction of EXISTING softly blended paint, no new physicalfinegrain or granular/powdery/furry/coarse mottled noise. No photometal/shine/glints/whiteplates/bevels/rims/scratches/etchedtexture/rust/bolts/rods/knurl/cracks/rings/raisedhardware/rocks/flametongues/curls/sparks/new fragments or new darkholes. Do not regularize asymmetry or sharpen originalshade. No new symbols/text/logos.

Output ONLY ENTIRE SAME opaque RGB square canvas with exactwholeUV/original count/material/sourceblur/patternscale/colorhierarchy. No whitespace/border/crop/zoom/cutout/composites; complete originalA/nativeType restored downstream, never altered originalcomposition.

source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.
